pages.text: This portal is an alternate dispute redressal mechanism at pre-litigation level. In case, the consumer is not satisfied, he/she can approach the appropriate Consumer Commission. Any grievance received either through online registration or call center is entered in the portal and a unique docket number is generated and given. Grievances received are sent to the concerned company / agency / regulator / ombudsman, as the case maybe, for speedy redress. Action taken is updated on real time basis by the concerned agency. As a follow up action, these agencies are reminded at stipulated interval. 6. How do I track the status of my Grievance? The status of the Grievance can be tracked from the portal under the link "Track your Grievance" without logging into the portal. NCH is a Pre-Litigation stage step. All efforts will be made to get the grievance redressed by taking up with the authorities concerned. However, if the grievance could not be redressed to the full satisfaction, a consumer has choice to approach the appropriate consumer Commission.
